title: Chernobyl dogs rapidly evolved

tellings.quote: there's a study that came out, or not even a study, an article that came out like this month, I think, about these dogs at Chernobyl that have rapidly evolved more than any other dog.

plain: Dogs living around Chernobyl, the site of the 1986 nuclear disaster, are said to have evolved faster than any other dogs. Michels brings it up from an article he says came out that month, in early 2025, without naming it, and first calls it a study before correcting himself.
